head: f847307e (scratch head 6e026552); compared with review 1 at 58295cc4 and the blockout at 8082e99a, same cameras and probes as review 1
summary: Better, and two review-1 blockers are really fixed, but not next to Halyard Marina tonight. Fixed and checked with my own runs: mid is clear below 7 m (the Tower Command start looks as open as the blockout), no loose prop stands on a walkable floor or in the lava (0 of 22,563 ghost vertices left), the lamps stand only on the four plinths, the Organ Pipes' bands and handles now ride the moving columns, the Surge Office's black squares are gone, the cards match Halyard's brightness (day 123.4 / top third 183.2 against 118.5 / 174.4; dusk 87.0 / 135.0 against 91.0 / 133.9), and decals 05-10 read. The hard limits all hold again (geometry byte-identical, every audit unchanged from the blockout, the lava tests, the bake in every mode, both matches with 0 lava deaths, perf under Halyard, GPU 0.91x by method C, ink still the loudest colour). What stops it: the new piece skins put a lid exactly level with the walkable top of the yard, terrace, Rim Head, Moorings and the whole spawn gallery, so 1,385 of the 3,695 m2 of paintable floor in Alpha's half z-fight. It shows as stripes and blocky patches in the spawn's first view, across the sweep, and through the team ink. Another 1,070 m2 of inkable wall is hidden under opaque skins, so ink painted there cannot be seen. At eye level the stage is still mostly boxes: textured cubes with a band and a cap stand in for bollards, cairns, outcrops, capstans, hornitos and mould stacks, and the Casting Hall and perimeter facades are flat colour. About 25 prop types were deleted to reach 0 ghosts rather than refitted, among them the pig beds, mould stacks and ladle stand on the Casting Floor, the ladle car, pipe manifolds, pattern doors and urns. The Organ Pipes are still flat grey prisms. The backdrop is a smooth pink cone, sphere puffs and a gradient band, and a flat orange cone face sits right behind the rim wall at eye level. My bare-piece count on review 1's 812-piece basis is 406 (was 621): 382 of these are the ground, ledges and terrain, which carry the stage surfaces and need no props, and 24 are objects (was 78). The builder's 838 / 844 counts every lid as dressing and leaves out everything below 0.3 m, so it does not measure what review 1 asked. The report's 'matched cameras on both sides' is again not true: the before halves are cropped from my review-1 base shots, label and all, and the after halves are other viewpoints.

reconciliation_bare_pieces.builder_838_of_844: caldera_piece_skins wraps every Alpha block 0.35-5.5 m tall and counts it dressed. issues.title: The piece skins z-fight with the walkable floors and hide the ink: stripes across the spawn, yard, terrace, Rim Head and Moorings
issues.evidence: arch.js D.caldera_piece_skins wraps every Alpha block 0.35-5.5 m tall. In its default branch it adds a 0.4 m basalt band w+0.025 x d+0.025 and a 0.04 m cap, both with their tops exactly at the block's top, so the floor blocks (yard, terrace, rim-head, gallery, moorings) get a lid level with their walkable top. Reviewer probe (probe-cover.js: every paintable face in Alpha's half sampled every 0.3 m, a dressing box 8 mm outside it = covered, 8 mm inside it = coplanar): of 3,695 m2 of paintable floor, 1,385 m2 coplanar and 301 m2 covered. That is the spawn gallery 230 / 230 m2, yard 592 / 693, terrace 211 / 215, rim-head 177 / 192 and moorings 86.5 / 91. Of 9,704 m2 of paintable wall, 1,070 m2 lie under opaque skins: terrace parapets 28 / 28, pattern shop 34 / 34, cupola stack 43 / 67, surge office 45 / 165, sand bin, lamp-post rack, flask stacks, valve chests and others at 100 %. In the pictures: stripes and blocky dither on the floor in spawnA (the first view a player gets), coping.0.0, gallery-stair.0.1, rim-head.0.0, moorings.0.0, gallery-side-stair.0.1, coping.3.0, gallery.0.0, pit-ramp.0.x and urn.x.x, in all four sweep sets. With lemon / grape ink splatted the Moorings and terrace ink is striped by the lid, and the parapet's wall ink is gone. The builder's caldera-art.js misses this because its ghost check counts only vertices more than 8 cm above the floor. Pictures: tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review2/r2-zfight-lids.jpg, r2-sweep-day-low-p02.jpg, r2-sweep-day-high-p00.jpg, r2-sweep-dusk-low-p03.jpg.
issues.fix: No dressing face may lie on or within 1 cm of a walkable or paintable top: stop every skin at least 2 cm below the top it dresses (never a lid), or leave floors to the stage surfaces. No opaque skin over a paintable wall either: dress walls with trims, plinths, pilasters and fittings, leaving most of the face visible (the aquarium's 'drawn under the ink' faces are the model), or make the face non-paintable where a skin must cover it, and tell the lead. Add both checks to caldera-art.js (0 m2 coplanar with a paintable face, covered paintable area listed by tag and justified), then re-shoot spawnA and the gallery, yard, terrace, Rim Head and Moorings views with ink in frame.

issues.title: At eye level it is still a stage of boxes: textured cubes with a band stand in for the foundry's objects, and the props that were objects were deleted
issues.evidence: Day LOW / day HIGH / dusk LOW / dusk HIGH sweeps, review 1's cameras. Each of these is one cube with the stage's cracked-flag texture and a band or cap: outcrop.0.0-2.2 and cairn.0.0-4.2 (natural rock as cubes), mooring-bollard.0.0-1.2, chain-bollard.0.0-1.2, capstan.0.0-0.2, stone-crate.0.0-0.2, race-bollard.0.0-0.2, vent-hood.0.0-0.2, mould-stack.0.0-0.2 and ladle-stand.1.0-3.2 (cubes with a white band). Others: slump-hornito.0.0-1.2 (brown boxes with yellow studs, not spatter cones), lamp-post-rack.0.0-0.2, flask-stack.0.0-1.2, moulding-floor.0.0-0.2, ingot-pile.0.x, casting-bed.0.x and chain-bin.0.x (plain brown boxes with a dark band), urn.0.0-2.1 (cubes) and gallery-lamp.0.0-1.2 (a green cube). Still flat: casting-hall.0.0 / 0.2 (flat 0.92 / 0.91: a flat red plane), pattern-bay.0.0-0.2 (flat 0.54), and the perimeter facades caldera-wall.*, rim-ridge.* and spatter-cone* (flat orange planes, flat yellow window strips, no brick, no cornice, no gutter). Since review 1, 25 placement types are gone from PLACEMENTS rather than refitted within 8.5 cm: pig beds, mould stacks, ladle stand, floor drain, ladle car, tide board, capstan, chain and mooring bollards, spillway bridge, slag pot, gauge post, pattern doors and crates, firebrick store and pallets, flask stack, weigh office, charging shed, casting stacks, pipe manifolds, planter urns, jib and cairn. For example, the Casting Floor's pig beds and the ladle stand's A-frame are gone, and the tide board, capstan and gallery lamps lost their detail. My bare count is 406 / 812 with 24 bare objects (reconciliation above); the remaining 382 are ground and ledges, which is fine. Pictures: tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review2/r2-still-boxes.jpg, r2-props-removed.jpg, r2-sweep-day-high-p13.jpg, r2-sweep-day-low-p13.jpg.
issues.fix: Put the objects back, fitted to the rule (within 8.5 cm of the block they dress, nothing on a walkable top, nothing coplanar), instead of deleting them: pig beds and ingot moulds on the Casting Floor, the ladle stand's frame and ladle, the ladle car on its rails, the capstan's drum and bars, bollards as cast-iron bollards (a lathe), cairns and outcrops as rock (a displaced or faceted mesh around the box), hornitos as spatter cones, flasks and mould boxes with their pins and handles, crates with slats and stencils. Give the Casting Hall and the perimeter facades brick, a plinth, pilasters, a cornice and windows with frames. Then go through the four sweep sets view by view, with the bare count and a list of every eye-level object in the report.

issues.title: The Organ Pipes still read as flat grey prisms, and the step links do not read as climbable from the island
issues.evidence: The rider dressing works mechanically (bands, plates, handles and a lamp in each look mesh, moving with the column at LOW, during the rise and at HIGH, no block added). But every lava:organL / organA / organB view is a flat, untextured grey or navy hexagonal prism: day HIGH views 452-504 have flat-block share 0.27-1.00 (organL:15.0.2 1.00, 16.0.2 0.87, 3.0.2 0.87), dusk HIGH and dusk LOW are near-uniform purple. The step plates (#3a3e45) are dark on a dark column, so only the yellow handles show. The 14 crown pipes are plain square sticks, and the socket collars (socket-collar.0.1, 1.0) are flat grey slabs. From the island the climb reads as yellow staples on a smooth column, not as steps. Pictures: tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review2/r2-organs.jpg, r2-sweep-day-high-p23.jpg, r2-sweep-day-high-p24.jpg, r2-sweep-dusk-high-p23.jpg, r2-sweep-dusk-high-p25.jpg.
issues.fix: Give the rider look meshes a material, not one flat colour: columnar basalt with joint lines and a lighter cap edge, worn iron bands with rivets, the step plates bright (galvanised checker plate, a yellow nosing) and proud of the face, the crown pipes as hexagonal basalt with caps, the socket collars as iron rings. Show each Organ at LOW and HIGH from the island at eye level so the climb reads in one look.

issues.title: The backdrop is primitives: a smooth pink cone, sphere puffs, a gradient band, and a flat orange cone face at eye level
issues.evidence: Cards (brightness now right): the Bellows Vent is a smooth, untextured salmon-pink cone filling the left third of the day card, the smoke is a cluster of opaque spheres, and the 'strata' are a blurred gradient band. A grey slab and sign on two masts hang over the rim on the right, beside a flat orange cone face (tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review2/r2-cards-backdrop.jpg, crops). At eye level caldera-wall.0.2 now looks out onto that flat orange plane where review 1 saw a black void (the void is closed; what closes it is untextured). backdrop-south and rim-west / rim-east show the same flat planes and the band. In review 1's hero camera the floors stripe (issue 1).
issues.fix: Model the crater wall as rock: a displaced or faceted mesh with real strata (texture or vertex colour), scree at its foot; the vent cone textured as scoria with a crater lip; smoke as soft billboards or layered translucent puffs; nothing floating (seat the masts and sign on the rim or remove them); no flat untextured plane visible from any sweep view.

issues.title: The report claims what was not done again: the pairs, the dressing count and the ghost check
issues.evidence: The report says all 8 pairs were shot with matched cameras on both sides. But the before halves of pair-casting-floor, pair-pour-floor and pair-gauge are crops of my review-1 base shots, with my label 'casting-floor base 55.5' / 'pour-floor base 74.2' still burned in, and the after halves come from the cameras the report lists, which are other viewpoints (tools/botlab/jobs/batch5/stages/caldera/out/review2/r2-builder-pairs.jpg). '838 of 844 dressed' counts lids and skips everything below 0.3 m (see the reconciliation). 'Ghosts: 0' is true but was reached by deleting 25 prop types, and the check skips faces level with the floor (issue 1).
issues.fix: Shoot both halves of every pair yourself with one camera list on both heads (8082e99a and the new head), and say in the report what was removed and why. Count dressing by what the pictures show, and make caldera-art.js check coplanarity and covered paintable area, so it fails on this head.

issues.title: Smaller things
issues.evidence: Decals 05-10 read now. But the stage surface's crack lines run across the sign faces (07, 08, 11), decal-11 is half hidden behind the office's door and window props, decal-04 is cut off at the frame edge, and decal-06's bottom line is lost. Dusk is better lit (lamps at piers, walls and the gallery) but still a purple murk on the island and the Organs, and several close lamp glows blow out to white blobs (pour-floor.0.4, casting-floor.0.0, lakefront.0.0, gauge-post.0.1). Ink: dusk aqua-cherry at HIGH is 8.2 % against Halyard's dusk 7.4 %: still leading, but do not brighten the seams further.
issues.fix: Keep the decals off the crack pattern (a clean plate behind each sign) and clear of props; frame decals 04 and 11 again; soften the lamp glows (smaller emissive spheres or less bloom at close range); lift dusk fill on the island.
